title: Clustering Algorithms Sandbox
summary: Synthetic dataset clustered with K-Means, naive agglomerative, and DBSCAN. Visualises centroids, dataset radius, inertia, and silhouette scores.

vr_notes.comfort: Static environment; only point height animates when clusters are assigned.
vr_notes.interaction: Cycle algorithms or reseed the dataset with helper methods bound to controls.
vr_notes.performance: <600 lightweight meshes plus centroid spheres; safe for desktop and high-end standalone.

parameters.name: sample_count
parameters.description: Number of synthetic samples to generate.

parameters.name: cluster_count
parameters.description: Target number of clusters for K-Means/Agglomerative.

parameters.name: dbscan_min_points
parameters.description: Minimum neighbours for DBSCAN to promote a core point.
